description: Retrieves the status of an asynchronous connection move job. Use this endpoint to monitor the progress of a connection move operation that was initiated with the `CONTINUE_WITH_DATA` sync behavior.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection. Retrieve it from the `id` field in the [List All Connections](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/list-connections) response, or from the `id` field returned when you [Create a Connection](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/create-connection).

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the move job. This is returned in the response when you initiate a connection move.

id.description: The unique identifier of the move job. Use this value to check the status of the move operation.

status.description: The current status of the move job. Possible values: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED.

connection_id.description: The unique identifier of the connection that was moved.

source_group_id.description: The unique identifier of the destination group the connection was moved from.

destination_group_id.description: The unique identifier of the destination group to move the connection to. Retrieve group IDs from the [List All Groups](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/groups/list-all-groups) endpoint.

created_at.description: The timestamp of when the move job was created.

started_at.description: The timestamp of when the move job started processing. Null if the job has not started yet.

completed_at.description: The timestamp of when the move job completed (successfully or with failure). Null if the job has not completed yet.

error_message.description: The error message if the move job failed. Null if the job has not failed.
